messages:
tara: Kickoff for "Starter Labs" launch post + webinar + inbound routing. Aim: showcase a tutorial-driven refapp, reproducible benchmark, and clear CTA to clone the repo. Quick decisions needed on webinar format and lead tags.

ben: I can write the long-form blog and landing page. Hero line idea: "Build a production-ready riff on your first LLM feature in under an hour." Keep heavy metrics in the benchmark appendix.

miko: I'll run the live demo and author the hands-on lab. Recommend a 20m demo + 30m lab so people finish with a working example.

rahul: I'll prepare a concise benchmark notebook with reproducible configs. Quick numbers for marketing: median token latency and cost-per-1k tokens for default and quantized profiles. I'll also add a small table that links to the notebook in the repo.

tara: Routing: we want signups to create a lead in Pardot (marketing CRM) and post events to Slack #devrel-inbound-starterlabs. Tag leads with source=starter-labs-webinar and interest=tutorial.

ben: Landing form fields: email, company, role, primary use-case, interest (checkboxes: tutorial, enterprise eval, partner). I'll include an opt-in for workshop followup.

miko: Repo plan: starter-labs/org-starter-labs with minimal README, quickstart script, demo notebook, and the benchmark notebook Rahul mentioned. I'll open a PR by next Tuesday.

devrel-bot: Created channel #devrel-inbound-starterlabs and posted webhook URL.

rahul: Bench preview: fp16 baseline ~110ms/token median on our harness; int8 quant ~70ms/token with a small eval delta (~1.2%). I'll include scripts to run the harness and reproduce the numbers.

tara: Webinar date proposal: Oct 12, 10am PT. Deadlines: landing copy by Sep 22, repo & lab by Sep 29, benchmark notebook by Sep 30, slides by Oct 6. Any conflicts?

sam: No conflicts from ops; I'll reserve the webinar slot and create a simple tracker doc with owners. We'll sync again next week for PR reviews and a run-through. :thumbsup:
